Also available at: http://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/ PDF/rr/rr5109.pdf (accessed 02/04/08) Hepatitis Though hepatitis may have many causes, viral hepatitis describes infections caused by agents that primarily target the liver. Five hepatitis viruses are recognised to be prima- rily responsible for infection in humans and have been named hepatitis A, B, C, D, and E. Hepatitis may also oc- cur as part of the clinical course of other viral infections, including CMV, Epstein-Barr virus, herpes simplex virus, rubella, varicella-zoster, and yellow fever infections.
